children: CEO John Ternus has sent his first message ahead of the company's biggest product event since he took over, giving investors an early signal about what is coming.
Ternus described next week's launch as phenomenal in a message to employees, Bloomberg News reported Tuesday. Apple is set to host the event on Sept. 9 at the Steve Jobs Theater in Cupertino.
The company is expected to unveil the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, as well as its first foldable iPhone. The new device could open a new revenue stream in the premium smartphone market.

IDC expects Apple to ship more than 17 million foldable iPhones by 2027, potentially giving it about 40% of the global foldable market. Bloomberg has reported the foldable model could be priced above $2,000.
The timing also brings challenges, with memory costs rising amid demand from AI data centers.

What it means for the stock: Ternus' upbeat message could build investor interest ahead of the launch, while actual demand will determine whether the event becomes a meaningful catalyst for Apple shares.

title: Apple CEO Sends First Message Ahead of Massive iPhone 18 Launch
